title: Test Movie: any keypress reloads the running SWF
description: User report: pressing any key while the Ruffle test-movie window is open causes the movie to reload immediately. Likely causes to investigate: Shell global keyboard shortcut handlers staying active while PlayerWindow is open and triggering state changes that remount RufflePlayer (each remount recreates the blob URL and reloads); or a keydown handler in PlayerWindow/RufflePlayer itself. Expected Flash 8 behavior: while Test Movie is focused, keyboard input goes to the MOVIE (Key.isDown etc. must work for authored content); only window-manager keys (Esc/Ctrl+W close, Ctrl+Enter re-test) act on the window, and authoring shortcuts are suspended. Fix focus scoping (disable Shell shortcuts while player open / stop propagation at the player container) and make RufflePlayer stable across parent re-renders (memo + stable blob URL). See docs/16-player-runtime.md.
